part: Orders package skeleton with authority, server entry, and static host page
why: A first program needs one checked package shape that starts an HTTP server and serves a page.

part: Typed route helpers for path parameters, query decoding, status responses, and redirects
why: The current mux handles path patterns, but query extraction and response conventions must be rebuilt by each web package.

part: Typed form decoder with required-field, numeric-range, and error-display helpers
why: The probe had to read raw text, split pairs, and validate fields before a create action could be safe.

part: SSR page plus browser-island template using reactive state and serializable props
why: The server and client built separately, but a battery should show their boundary and hydration data in one example.

part: SQLite migration, policy scope, query, mutation, and explicit invalidation fixture
why: A working data route needs persistence and a visible refetch after mutation, not only an isolated database call.

part: Session login, cookie round trip, protected route, and failure cases
why: Auth is part of the smallest useful full-stack app and should be exercised over HTTP.

part: Deterministic end-to-end harness with a local listener and client requests
why: The probe used one executable flow to prove list, create, detail, login, protection, and assets together.

part: Web and native build smoke commands with manifest and compiler diagnostics
why: The client target built, while the native server exposed a compiler failure that a first-party battery must catch.

part: Dev watcher fixture that edits a route and records restart or state retention
why: The watcher rebuilt and restarted after an edit; the battery must make in-memory state retention observable.
